entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: A human boy of Innistrad rescued by Avacyn, who survived the burning of his village.

entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: Maeli's mother, who prayed to Avacyn and was burned to ash by her.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel who rescued Maeli, then fell into madness after Emrakul's presence was felt.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose presence on Innistrad corrupted Avacyn.

entities.name: Sadie
entities.description: Ms. Sadie, who adopted Maeli and was later Eldrazified.

events.summary: Avacyn hears Kelse's prayer and rescues the lost Maeli.
events.quote: the angel heard her, and rescued Maeli, returning him to her mother.

events.summary: The presence of Emrakul makes itself known and Avacyn begins her descent into madness.
events.quote: Avacyn started her descent into madness from that point.

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels burn the village; Kelse sends Maeli running and Avacyn burns her to ash.
events.quote: Avacyn herself made particularly sure to burn Kelse to ash.

events.summary: Maeli is adopted by Ms. Sadie, and later defended by two Cathar after Sadie is Eldrazified.
events.quote: Maeli was later adopted by Ms. Sadie .

relations.quote: his mother Kelse prayed so hard to Avacyn
Avacyn herself made particularly sure to burn Kelse to ash.
